summary.text: In October 2025, as VA Secretary, Collins said AI is helping the Department of Veterans Affairs provide faster and more efficient services without cutting corners. In January 2025 statements, Collins said he was not willing to take AI off the table but was also not willing to have AI used randomly, especially with benefits and more difficult cases, and he described using AI for easier benefit cases while keeping hands-on handling for harder ones. In May 2025, Collins said VA was adding AI to help doctors, nurses, and practitioners, and in January 2025 he said he was willing to look at any opportunity, including AI, to get veterans benefits quicker. In January 2025 and August 2026 statements, Collins said there will always be a person to oversee the process and that a person actually does the actual claim.
